title: Iterated Weil-map square for the explicit powered geometric pullback
statement: Let k0 and k1 be finite fields, l a prime invertible in both, X/k0 and C/k1 schemes, r a natural number, and v: Cbar -> Xbar intertwine Fr_C with Fr_X^r. Let P be the explicit powered geometric pullback [def-zl-powered-geometric-pullback]. Specify the induced equality Fr_C^m v = v Fr_X^(r*m) (automatically obtained by powering the given square). For a constructible source Weil sheaf G [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] and m >= 0, let theta:v^*G -> P(G) be its canonical carrier identification. The square of underlying pro-etale sheaf morphisms intertwines the m-fold Weil map of P(G) with the pulled-back (r*m)-fold Weil map of G [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]: upperStarComp(Fr_C^m,v) ; (Fr_C^m)^*(theta) ; phi_PG,m equals upperStarCongr(Fr_C^m v = v Fr_X^(r*m)) ; upperStarComp(v,Fr_X^(r*m)) ; v^*(phi_G,r*m) ; theta. These are actual sheaf morphisms before choosing any points, residue fields, or characteristic polynomials.

proof.text: Prove a private composition lemma for squares of underlying sheaf maps using naturality of upperStarComp, upperStarCompIso, and upperStarCompIso_hom_app_paste. Derive the identity exchange from the compositor unit laws at the level of natural isomorphisms, then prove its sheaf square generically. The zero Weil maps are the identity-pullback units; generic substitution of these structure maps gives the zero square. Keeping functors abstract avoids unfolding concrete pullback constructions.

proof.text: Prove the scheme-level commutation of powers for arbitrary category automorphisms. Prove the sheaf square by a generic induction on m for arbitrary automorphisms and arbitrary families of structure maps satisfying zero, successor and source-block composition laws: paste the preceding square and the first square by the private composition lemma. Specialize this induction to the actual Weil structure maps, spelling out the sheaf objects in the composition and the actual Frobenius automorphisms, without local let aliases, so elaboration and kernel checking do not unfold the concrete constructions. The zero law is frobeniusPowStr_zero and the generic identity-square calculation. The target successor law is upperStarFactor_hom_app_comp_frobeniusPowStr_succ. The source-block law is upperStarFactor_hom_app_comp_frobeniusPowStr_add, extended to a zero second index using the identity-pullback unit law, and to a specified result index so arithmetic rewrites stay outside concrete pullback functors. A generic compositor-cancellation lemma recovers exactly the original displayed theorem.

theorem poweredGeometricPullback_frobeniusPowStr (G : WeilSheaf k₀ l X) (m : ℕ)
    (hvm : ((C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ m).hom ≫ v =
      v ≫ ((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ (r * m)).hom) :
    (ProEtale.upperStarComp _
      ((C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ m).hom v).hom.app G.obj.carrier.X ≫
      (((C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ m).hom)^*[_].map
        (poweredPullbackCarrierIso v r hv G).hom ≫
      ((poweredGeometricPullback v r hv).obj G).frobeniusPowStr m =
    (ProEtale.upperStarCongr _ hvm).hom.app G.obj.carrier.X ≫
      (ProEtale.upperStarComp _ v
        ((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ (r * m)).hom).hom.app G.obj.carrier.X ≫
      (v)^*[_].map (G.frobeniusPowStr (r * m)) ≫
      (poweredPullbackCarrierIso v r hv G).hom
